Q201.reason: Hypernatraemic dehydration arises when a person takes in excess water, which dilutes the body's sodium and so produces the raised sodium reading.

Q202.reason: The main reason for the upright posture is practical rather than physiological: it puts the patient's mouth and chest in full view so that the clinician can watch each blow and check the technique.
